description:
Enpass is a cross-platform password management app to securely store passwords and other credentials in a virtual vault locked with a master password. Unlike most other popular password managers, Enpass is an offline password manager.


Bug Fixes
- Keyfile Selection: Keyfile selection in backups now appears when restoring a backup from Enpass settings. Previously, the option to select a keyfile was missing during the restoration process.
- Shared Item Addition: Shared items now add to your vault after you validate the Pre-Shared Key (PSK). Previously, the items were mistakenly not added even after successful validation.
- Application Stability: Fixed a crash that could occur immediately after unlocking the app.
- Sync Error Handling: Fixed an issue where downgrading to an older version of Enpass would show an "Incorrect Password" error instead of correctly identifying that the app version was out of date.
This version also includes other minor bug fixes and improvements.
